---
title: "False-positive rate for the variance test"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

library(car)  # for Levene
```

## Generate data

```{r}
r_with_kurtosis <- function(n, kappa, mu = 0, sigma = 1) {
  stopifnot(kappa > 1, sigma > 0)

  if (kappa < 3) {
    # Beta(a, a), standardized to mean 0 and variance 1
    a <- 3 * (kappa - 1) / (2 * (3 - kappa))
    u <- rbeta(n, shape1 = a, shape2 = a)
    z <- (u - 0.5) / sqrt(1 / (4 * (2 * a + 1)))

  } else if (kappa == 3) {
    z <- rnorm(n)

  } else {
    # t_nu has kurtosis 3 + 6/(nu - 4)
    nu <- 4 + 6 / (kappa - 3)
    z <- rt(n, df = nu) * sqrt((nu - 2) / nu)
  }

  mu + sigma * z
}
```

## Simulate the FPR

```{r}
var_test_pval <- function(s1, s2) {
    var.test(s1, s2)$p.value
}
```

```{r}
simulate_fpr <- function(kappa, alpha = 0.05, sample_size = 100, repeats = 10000, pval_fun = var_test_pval) {
    rejected <- replicate(repeats, {
        s1 <- r_with_kurtosis(sample_size, kappa)
        s2 <- r_with_kurtosis(sample_size, kappa)
        pval_fun(s1, s2) < alpha
    })
    
    n_rejected <- sum(rejected)
    ci <- binom.test(n_rejected, repeats)$conf.int

    data.frame(
        kappa = kappa,
        sample_size = sample_size,
        fpr = n_rejected / repeats,
        lower = ci[1],
        upper = ci[2]
    )
}
```

## Two-sample F-test

```{r}
results <- map(
    seq(2, 5, length.out = 10),
    simulate_fpr
) |> list_rbind()
```

```{r}
ggplot(results, aes(x = kappa, y = fpr)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") + 
    geom_ribbon(
        aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
        fill = "#4C78A8", alpha = 0.20
    ) +
    geom_line(colour = "#1F4E79", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(colour = "#1F4E79", size = 2) +  
    labs(
        x = "Population kurtosis",
        y = "Empirical Type-I error rate",
        title = "Calibration of the two-sample F test under non-normality"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()   

ggsave("vartest.pdf", height = 6, units = "cm")
```


## Levene test

```{r}
levene_pval <- function(s1, s2) {
    out <- leveneTest(
        c(s1, s2), as.factor(c(rep(0, length(s1)), rep(1, length(s2))))
    )
    out$`Pr(>F)`[[1]]
}

results <- map(
    seq(2, 5, length.out = 10),
    \(kappa) simulate_fpr(kappa, pval_fun = levene_pval)
) |> list_rbind()
```

```{r}
ggplot(results, aes(x = kappa, y = fpr)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") + 
    geom_ribbon(
        aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
        fill = "#4C78A8", alpha = 0.20
    ) +
    geom_line(colour = "#1F4E79", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(colour = "#1F4E79", size = 2) +  
    labs(
        x = "Population kurtosis",
        y = "Empirical Type-I error rate",
        title = "Calibration of the Levene test under non-normality"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()   

ggsave("levene.pdf", height = 6, units = "cm")
```

## Fligner test


```{r}
fligner_pval <- function(s1, s2) {
    out <- fligner.test(
        c(s1, s2), as.factor(c(rep(0, length(s1)), rep(1, length(s2))))
    )
    out$p.value
}

results <- map(
    seq(2, 5, length.out = 10),
    \(kappa) simulate_fpr(kappa, pval_fun = fligner_pval)
) |> list_rbind()
```

```{r}
ggplot(results, aes(x = kappa, y = fpr)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +

        aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
```
